description: Work by Riya Dutta: LinkedIn campaigns, a website, the content system behind them, and research on how people decide.
intro: Campaigns, a website, the system that makes the campaigns, and research. Filter by what each piece shows.

items.title: The Haunted CRM
items.blurb: Fifteen CRM problems told as ghost stories across five days.

items.title: The Founder Bottleneck
items.blurb: One week, three chapters, on what stops when everything runs through the founder.
